messages:
marco (eng-sre): Postmortem INC-1955 posted. Root cause: KV eviction cascade exposing autoscaler lag. I sketched a short set of runbook edits we should land this sprint.

marco (eng-sre): Quick remediation list (owners/due):
- KV health triage: hit ratio, eviction tail, TTL skew (priya, 2025-07-02)
- Containment 'safe-fallback' commands + parseable diag output (alex, 2025-07-04)
- Explicit escalation windows for autoscaler failures (zoe, 2025-07-01)
- Tag recurring-pattern + schedule 30d trend check (marco, 2025-07-15)

priya (eng-platform): I'll add triage steps and a one-click fallback toggle (link to dashboard + runbook header).

alex (eng-runtime): Taking containment. Draft snippet for runbook below, will include example grep lines for oncall:

```
# safe-fallback: limit concurrency and set cache readonly
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-api --replicas=1
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-api KV_CACHE_MODE=readonly
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/inference-api -- python -m redwood.tools.kv_dump --recent-evictions=30 | head -n 50
# recommended grep: grep "evicted_at" | tail -n 5
```

zoe (infra): For escalation windows propose explicit timings: 0-5m ack -> oncall-sre, 5-20m -> platform-pager, 20-60m -> infra lead + exec. I'll add rotation links and a sample pager playbook snippet.

marco (eng-sre): Nice. Please also add a small telemetry query (Grafana) to the triage block so oncall can run it without opening dashboards.

priya (eng-platform): Will paste the query in PR. Creating draft runbook now.

runbook-bot: Draft runbook created by priya: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction-remediation-draft PR #621. Walkthrough scheduled after PR ready.

alex (eng-runtime): One more: include a note that Optimize team ticket exists for model-variant fallback; runbook stays focused on triage/containment.

marco (eng-sre): Agreed. Merge PR after walkthrough and tag runbook with postmortem link + recurring-pattern. Follow-up thread for walkthrough notes will be posted here. :thumbsup:
